title: LADA Beerteam vs Puck Buddies Ice, Oct 18
notes: Home game at Kirkland: we wore white and sat at the left bench (not the right one the home team usually takes), and #10 served his penalty in the bottom-left box. The 3438x1374 LiveBarn recording, uploaded Oct 31, sat 53 px lower than Kirkland's usual framing under a black band; it was re-encoded shifted back up before detection, so the rink's geometry and the ice-map calibration fit unchanged. The game sheet (SportNinja, read through its public API) gave the score, the goals with scorers, the penalties, the shots and who played; the arena scoreboard and the video confirmed them.

Periods by the scoreboard clock (we were HOME): 0:09-18:10, 19:47-39:38 and 41:21-65:31 of the video. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd. The video runs to the final horn. Final 5-1, shots 31-12 (7-4, 12-2, 12-6), from the sheet; the board agreed. Early in the 1st the board put our first goal on the guest side for about two minutes before correcting it.

Goals at 4:17, 26:09, 29:30, 52:37, 58:25 and 64:27 of the video, each found by eye and matched to the board's clock. The page keeps the sheet's credits, but the frame check saw something else on three: on the 2nd goal (Kleiman #69, assist Solovyov #87) Solovyov jammed it in at the near post; on the 3rd (Kleiman, assist Shikhanov #70) Kleiman jammed at the pads and Solovyov's poke may have put it in; on the 5th (Bogdanov #10, assists Tverskoy #44 and Zhaksilikov #23) the puck came out from under the goalie after Tverskoy's battle at the crease and trickled in without touching Bogdanov's stick. On the 1st goal the solve doesn't have Shikhanov #70 (credited with an assist) on the ice; the frames couldn't settle it, and he comes on 4 s after it.
Our penalty: Bogdanov #10, hooking along the far boards at 34:31 of the video (2nd period 4:03; arm up at 34:31, whistle at 34:33), 3:00 on the board, in the box until 38:00. Killed off.

Ten skaters and Mayorov #1 in goal. Belousenko #13 (Vladimir, a sub; not Alexei #11) played the most. Solovyov #87 arrived late: he is first on the ice at 13:50 of the video (about 4:20 left in the 1st) and was neither on the ice nor at our bench at any change before it. Absent: Zhaksilikov #5 (in LADA's planned lines, but not marked playing; every read of '5' was Papusha #25's back), Belousenko #11, Khristoforov #7, Egiazarov #27, Zakharov #34, Gilderman #41, Volkov #94, goalie Starodubtsev #20 and the other subs.

Fixed by hand after frame checks of every stretch the lineup check flagged (21 on/off spans; no review rows changed): Shikhanov #70 on at 10:14-10:59 of the video on unlabeled tracks, with Belousenko #13 off from 10:17; line changes at 10:53-11:03, 12:34-13:01, 31:50-31:52 and 34:05-34:26 (Kleiman #69 never left); Papusha #24 on for the 3rd period's first 1:51; the stoppage changes at 45:23-46:25, 46:59-47:07 and around the last goal, and Solovyov #87 on from 64:45 to the end. Bogdanov's 10 s shift right before his penalty is too short to count. A 15 s stretch with five of ours on during the kill (34:34-34:49) is the change in the stoppage after the whistle and stays.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 13:41: Bogdanov drives the net and it goes in as the goalie drops, 1-0
2nd period, clock 11:32: jammed in at the near post after Solovyov's rush, 2-0
2nd period, clock 9:06: Kleiman jams at the pads and it goes in from the scramble, 3-0
3rd period, clock 8:56: Allen #48 jams a loose puck at the goal line over, 3-1
3rd period, clock 5:02: the puck squirts out from under the sprawled goalie and trickles in after Tverskoy's battle at the crease, 4-1
3rd period, clock 0:33: Tverskoy jams it in at the right post with the goalie down, 5-1
2nd period, clock 4:03: hooking along the far boards; 3 minutes on the board, killed
